newsitem.title: UK: Rolls Royce soars on aero engines hopes.
newsitem.headline: Rolls Royce soars on aero engines hopes.

text.p: Shares in engineering group and aero-engine manufacturer Rolls Royce Plc gained over three percent on Wednesday as a switch into the sector continued with investors encouraged by an upbeat Daily Express report. Rolls Royce shares touched a new year's high of 251p in morning trade before slipping back to 250p, up 7-1/2p.
"The market -- and this sector in particular -- is enjoying some revived interest and the Daily Express report is helping push the stock higher," one marketmaker said.
In an upbeat report, the newspaper said Rolls Royce was poised to dominate the aero engines business early next century.
